reviewer: Codex visual inspection; not an independent human annotator
interpretation: All six sheets inspected. Five saved frames cannot certify intersample contact, load-bearing or post-H8 stability. RGB is supplementary evidence only.

observations.note: task01_init32 contact geometry is small/occluded at 128px. Neither bilateral contact nor stability is visually resolvable. Retain raw diagnostics and unknown strong labels.
The sampled images show gripper/object configurations changing through transport-like motion; this does not independently verify load-bearing or continuous grasp.
Loss-of-contact examples show substantially different object/gripper configurations. Placement-like and dropped/misplaced outcomes cannot all be labelled harmful release from contact loss alone.

Prefix-zero examples have about -71.6mm recorded target z change without target-gripper contact. Height change alone is not robot-caused lifting; initialization/settling is a candidate explanation, not causally isolated.
On/plate contact in terminal-like images is not proof of release and sustained stability. No hold-duration label assigned.
